stage: Part II Stage02 — 끝나지 않는 진혼곡의 무희
scope: Three independent full-body object-body concepts referenced from actual Part I bosses. Existing Part II human designs not supplied as inputs.
shared_visual_qa: All three selected outputs were visually inspected. None has a real human face, pupils, facial acting, natural hair, a bald human head or a class costume. Bodies are sculptural shells, resonance organs and supported drive mechanisms. Music functions through external sound plates/rails and links; no gold pin cylinder displayed inside a torso. Clean ivory/light-gold/navy planes, lavender cel shading and controlled contours retained. All selected outputs are 1536x1024 landscape concept images, not turnarounds or verified 3D meshes.

references.role: Object as main living body, cavity/support logic, shell thickness and limited mechanisms.
Carved large masses, strong joint scale and soft illustrated planes.

assets.design_ko: 가로로 큰 세 공명낭과 초승달 외피가 본체이며 네 록커 다리로 강제 박자를 밟는다. 등 태엽축과 외부 두 타격기·음판, 측면 위상 시계가 동일 구동틀에 연결된다.
assets.qa: Four distinct supported rocker legs and complete feet; no humanoid parts. External tone plates, supported hammers, one rear winding key and side phase dial visible. Whole silhouette contained in canvas. No internal pin drum or copied bell-spider anatomy.

assets.title_ko: 조각 손의 무용틀 — 인체 흔적이 잠식된 혼성기관

references.role: Oversized carved hands, heavy joint mass and faceted surfaces.
Fixed doll shells, pivot sockets and supported panel logic; face/hair/costume excluded.
Object-body support frame, acoustic void and functional mechanisms.

assets.design_ko: 빈 목 소켓과 큰 조각 손·팔만 인체의 흔적으로 남고 대부분 몸체는 비스듬한 거대 음향 외피/다섯 외부 음판/구동틀로 바뀐다. 긴 손은 저항하듯 펼쳐지고 다른 손은 공명 레일을 누른다. 세 구동 다리가 몸을 강제로 움직인다.
assets.qa: Final correction removed an unintended fourth rear leg and expanded framing. Selected image has exactly three main attached legs, two complete carved hands, empty neck socket and no human head/face. Five external sound boards, rail, rear key and closed spring housing visible. Internal gold pin-cylinder display absent. All fingers/feet/key have margins.

assets.title_ko: 봉인 무대 인형 — 얼굴 없는 의례체

references.role: Closed sculpted shell as body and controlled broad ivory planes; face excluded.
Precisely attached doll pivots and shell seams; no source face, hair, outfit or scissors.
Clean functional mechanisms, supported acoustic parts and illustrated materials.

assets.design_ko: 육면체에 가까운 봉인 두상과 밀폐된 길고 좁은 몸껍질을 가진 무대 인형. 한 손은 펴지고 다른 손은 흉부를 막은 채 두 다리가 강제 스텝에 고정된다. 등 태엽과 허리 위상 캠이 외부 다섯 공명 레일을 구동한다.
assets.qa: Head is sealed faceted cap with no eyes/nose/lips or hair. Two segmented arms/hands and exactly two supported legs, with both feet contacting floor. Closed torso, rear spring/flat winding handle, side clock-phase cam and five externally supported tone bars visible. Full silhouette stays within frame.
